topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I found out today that my childhood best friend doesn't remember me. We spent countless afternoons exploring the woods, building forts, and dreaming up grand adventures. Yet, it’s as if all those moments slipped through the cracks of her memory. I can’t help but replay our times together, wondering what I could have done differently, what I might have overlooked. Maybe I didn’t leave a lasting impression, or perhaps I was just one of many faces in a crowded past. I know I should move on, let it go, but the weight of this silence feels like a burden I’m destined to carry.
